avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP · max 5 MB · generates profile (400×400) and thumbnail (80×80)

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Besides the email code, asks for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…) when signing in.
twoFactor.setupDescription: Scan the QR code with your app (or type the key) and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.invalidCode: The code is not valid. Check that your phone's clock is right.
twoFactor.backupDescription: Keep them somewhere safe: each one works once when you don't have your phone. They are not shown again.
twoFactor.disableConfirmDescription: The email code will be enough to sign in.
twoFactor.error: The operation could not be completed
